# AK Infotech - Wholesale & Retail CCTV Security Systems

> AK Infotech is an authorized distributor and wholesale/retail supplier of CCTV surveillance systems, security cameras, DVR/NVR recorders, biometric systems, PoE networking switches, surveillance hard drives, and accessories based in Mount Road, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India.

## Store Information
- **Business Name:** AK Infotech
- **Website:** https://shop.akinfotechcctv.in/
- **Address:** No.19, Shop No: F22 & F23, 1st Floor, Uno Arcade A/C Complex, Meeran Sahib Street, Mount Road, Chennai - 600002, Tamil Nadu, India.
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +91 9500673207
- **Email:** admin@akinfotechcctv.in / akinfotechtn@gmail.com
- **Operating Hours:** Monday to Saturday: 10:00 AM – 7:30 PM (Sunday Closed)
- **GSTIN:** 33CPAPA9563H1Z1 (Eligible for 18% B2B Input Tax Credit - ITC)

## Core Policies & Customer Guarantees
- **Cash on Delivery (COD):** Available for orders across India. Customers pay a small advance commitment during online checkout, with the remaining balance collected at doorstep upon delivery.
- **Shipping Time:** Fast dispatch across India. Delivery timeline is **3 to 7 business days** via Shiprocket Express Courier and regional parcel networks.
- **Return & Replacement Policy:** **3-Day Replacement Window**. Replacements are accepted within 3 days of delivery strictly if the product arrives damaged in transit or if a different product from what was ordered is delivered.
- **Warranty:** 100% genuine products with full official manufacturer warranties (CP Plus, Hikvision, Dahua, Trueview, Qubo, TP-Link, Realtime, ESSL).

## Product Categories
- [WIFI CCTV Cameras](https://shop.akinfotechcctv.in/categories/wifi-cctv.html): Smart PTZ, indoor robo cameras, outdoor 4G/Wi-Fi cameras with 2-way audio.
- [HD Analog Cameras](https://shop.akinfotechcctv.in/categories/hd-cctv.html): 2MP, 3MP, 5MP, and 4K bullet and dome cameras.
- [IP Cameras](https://shop.akinfotechcctv.in/categories/ip-cctv.html): High-resolution PoE network security cameras with AI motion detection.
- [HD DVR Recorders](https://shop.akinfotechcctv.in/categories/hd-dvr.html): 4-channel, 8-channel, 16-channel, and 32-channel network recorders.
- [NVR Recorders](https://shop.akinfotechcctv.in/categories/nvr.html): IP network video recorders with 4K output.
- [CCTV Combo Packs](https://shop.akinfotechcctv.in/categories/cctv-combo.html): Complete all-in-one DIY security camera setups with DVR, cables, SMPS, and hard drive.
- [PoE Switches & Networking](https://shop.akinfotechcctv.in/categories/poe-switch.html): 4-port, 8-port, 16-port, 24-port Gigabit PoE switches and accessories.
- [Surveillance Hard Disks](https://shop.akinfotechcctv.in/categories/hard-disk.html): 1TB to 12TB surveillance-rated drives from Western Digital Purple and Seagate SkyHawk.
